user_intent: 期望 声音 处于 52 dB
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 52 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 52 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
